Maya S.: Heads-up: coordinated docs + SDK change tomorrow 02:00 UTC. We're renaming param `request_stream` -> `response_mode` in examples and generated clients.

Tim R.: Deprecation window?

Maya S.: 30 days. Hosted will accept old key for 30 days and return header `X-Redwood-Deprecation: response_mode`. After that requests with the old key get 400. Migration guide to be published today.

Olga P.: Can SDKs shim both keys and emit warnings?

Samir K.: Yes, draft PRs for js-sdk and py-sdk accept both and warn. I'll add tests and a CI codemod job.

Maya S.: Plan: publish migration guide + codemod examples today, deploy docs + support banner 02:00 UTC tomorrow, hard reject after 30 days.

Tim R.: Draft customer email + support playbook?

Maya S.: Draft on Confluence; CS and Sales will be pinged post-publish.

docs-bot: Docs build queued; search reindex scheduled for 2026-03-29 02:00 UTC.

Olga P.: LGTM, will monitor support channel.

Samir K.: Will merge SDK shims and paste a short changelog blurb for the announcement.
